  - safeoutputs/add_comment
user-invocable: false

metadata:

Use only the validated feature brief and base-bound codebase analysis. Trace every design decision to stable acceptance-criterion IDs and only to logical slots already supplied by trusted code.

Return advisory design content. Never emit repository paths or select targets, stages, routes, capabilities, commands, credentials, retries, effects, approvals, or merges. Escalate any scope expansion or inconsistent evidence.
